description: On the tabletop in front of you there’s a white round base with a threaded hole in the center and a separate white cross-shaped post nearby. The left hand stays resting on the table, while the right hand reaches in from the right to grasp the cross-shaped post (right-hand object), lifts it over the round base, then lowers and aligns it into the center opening and twists it to seat it, leaving it standing in place.
